title: 5-Seed CAMA Experiments on rel-stack/user-engagement, rel-trial/study-outcome, rel-trial/study-adverse
summary: Demo notebook analyzing pre-computed results from 30 training runs (2 methods x 3 tasks x 5 seeds) comparing HeteroSAGE+mean baseline vs HeteroSAGE+CAMA. Demonstrates the CAMAAggregation PyTorch module, re-computes Cohen's d with 10000-sample bootstrap 95% CI, analyzes learned gate values per edge type, and diagnoses study-adverse degenerate baselines. Includes a 3-panel visualization: per-seed metric comparison, effect size with CI, and gate deviation from 0.5. Data from rel-trial/study-outcome, rel-trial/study-adverse, and rel-stack/user-engagement tasks.
